sourceLevelGains.finding: Current exact accepted AC5 establishes Faction Champion as Humanoid for mechanical targeting, with a native Wizard route. The old absence-of-a-second-explicit-type source premise is superseded. This does not demonstrate a Banishment Gate nonmatching crossing.
constraints: actual legal acquisition, cast, body and command histories in the integrated test
conditional test facts remain conditional; no membership, native origin, soul, canonical faction or campaign event inferred

sourceLevelGains.finding: Accepted AC5 provides finite summoned-body ending, intrinsic-gear disappearance and genuine-object persistence/drop rules. Its accepted Elemental Banishment example AC5-X17 also provides separate-body and terminal cargo precedent in that exact interface. Neither is a new Gate case or a wholesale transfer of AC5-BANISH-EXT to Gate.
constraints: No corpse is produced by an expired Champion or Fire Pet.
No intrinsic equipment becomes loot or genuine cargo.
The accepted AC5 source expiry/cargo example is authored comparison evidence, not a full newly replayed Gate witness.

blockers.scope: Whole main case A: required multiple actual creature types and nonmatching control
blockers.historicalMissingText: Current demonstrated Water Pet profiles explicitly supply Elemental. The inspected current ordinary summon operational profiles and current AC4 sources did not establish a second concrete typed actor for this required control. Human ancestry, Spectral Steed, spell school, native plane and visual appearance do not supply that missing classification. This is not a claim that no qualifying source exists elsewhere.
blockers.missing: An integrated nonmatching crossing using the now-source-qualified Humanoid Champion against a gate fixed to Elemental, alongside retained matching ally/enemy admissions.

blockers.scope: Required automatic-guard and whole occupied-cell lifecycle witnesses
blockers.historicalMissingText: The two positive Elemental admissions are recorded, but the rule-only touch/type-change/already-claimed entries contain no concrete qualifying state transition. Separate living carried-body admission, primary escape, dead-primary/corpse handling and finite-summon expiry with real loose cargo are not demonstrated. An integrity pass cannot promote those entries.
blockers.missing: A complete body touches the boundary without crossing; the current event 4 only records a rule observation.; A real authorized type-changing source and actor, with a stationary body and no new crossing.; An already-spent creator/target/encounter guard followed by a genuine later crossing, plus duplicate-event treatment.; Full Gate admission with a separate living body being carried and explicit lawful separation/fit.; An acquired escape source that actually reaches a known authorized external site from this cell, and a paid successful escape.; An eligible admitted primary with a source-established death/corpse lifecycle and actual corpse handling.; An actual finite-summon source expiration inside a Gate cell with separately acquired genuine cargo.

minimumWitnesses.missing: An integrated nonmatching crossing using the now-source-qualified Humanoid Champion against a gate fixed to Elemental, alongside retained matching ally/enemy admissions.
minimumWitnesses.minimumWitness: Bind the accepted AC5 envelope/receipt and native Wizard route; enumerate the summoner acquisition/repertoire, full legal actor, source-qualified faction identifier and four eligibility inputs, paid Action/V/S/F/10 RP creation within 60 ft, concentration and 60-second source clock; give the Champion complete body/gear/custody and lawful command/phase/movement history through the 10x15 opening. Record no exile, no save and no hard-denial claim for nonmatching Humanoid, while the qualifying Elementals establish their own cells. Preserve unknown-type non-diagnostic behavior separately. Conditional case facts may be used under PG200-H02; do not call them actual campaign facts.

minimumWitnesses.missing: A complete body touches the boundary without crossing; the current event 4 only records a rule observation.
minimumWitnesses.minimumWitness: Use a source-legal typed body and lawful movement with explicit aperture/body geometry and before/after coordinates; demonstrate no admission, no cell and no claim; retain movement and resources exactly. No new general rule is required.

minimumWitnesses.missing: A real authorized type-changing source and actor, with a stationary body and no new crossing.
minimumWitnesses.minimumWitness: Bind a source that actually changes mechanical creature type, its lawful acquisition, payment, duration and body/cargo mapping. Process it at an unchanged position and show no gate trigger merely from the change. Do not turn school, appearance, ancestry, separate summon replacement or visual transformation into a same-body type transition.

minimumWitnesses.missing: An already-spent creator/target/encounter guard followed by a genuine later crossing, plus duplicate-event treatment.
minimumWitnesses.minimumWitness: Fork an actually admitted target with its existing claim; settle/return it lawfully without resetting encounter/creator/body IDs, then pay the later movement/command opportunity and attempt the crossing. Show no second cell or refreshed claim. A duplicate crossing ID reuses its receipt; a distinct crossing cannot erase the spent guard.

minimumWitnesses.missing: Full Gate admission with a separate living body being carried and explicit lawful separation/fit.
minimumWitnesses.minimumWitness: Bind both complete bodies, carried relation, consent/permission where required, custody and geometry. Demonstrate the separate creature remains at the origin when lawful separation succeeds; if impossible, show atomic exile failure with no claim, deletion or creature-to-gear conversion. AC5-X17 is a source-backed comparison, not this Gate history.

minimumWitnesses.missing: An acquired escape source that actually reaches a known authorized external site from this cell, and a paid successful escape.
minimumWitnesses.minimumWitness: Bind the route, actor acquisition, actual eligible target/destination, costs/components/opportunity, destination knowledge/geometry and applicable blockers. Trace primary escape ending only its own cell, settling residual cargo once, preserving other cells/gate and all independent clocks. No default teleport or invented destination.

minimumWitnesses.missing: An eligible admitted primary with a source-established death/corpse lifecycle and actual corpse handling.
minimumWitnesses.minimumWitness: Bind a complete typed primary whose actual lifecycle leaves remains, its lawful admission, actual lethal/zero/death settlement, extant corpse and original equipment/cargo, then exact cell closure/return or terminal placement conflict. The finite Champion/Fire Pet ending cannot supply a corpse.

minimumWitnesses.missing: An actual finite-summon source expiration inside a Gate cell with separately acquired genuine cargo.
minimumWitnesses.minimumWitness: Instantiate the accepted finite profile under its real route and eligibility, pay creation, record original deadline and cargo owner/custodian/physical identity before admission. At that original deadline end the body/intrinsic gear without a corpse; preserve loose genuine cargo and apply only Gate's expressly selected terminal settlement. Record occupied return/blocked placement, no duplicate item, no second ending/refill/refund, and complete actor/attached clocks.
